messages:
sylvie: Quick follow-up from the postmortem thread. We need to close out comms action items and agree a publish workflow: short public statuspage line, a 72-hour customer brief (public), an expanded customer brief for affected enterprise accounts, and policy for full RCAs (NDA/gated). Also note recurring KV-eviction pattern that needs engineering follow-up.

omar: I can own the statuspage copy. Draft suggestion: "Elevated latency affecting Text Gen API between 02:1402:50 UTC due to cache eviction during a model rollout. Rollback and throttling applied. No customer data exposed. Full postmortem to follow after review."

jen: That looks good. Add a single mitigation sentence: "Rollback + temporary throttling applied to stabilize traffic." Legal will confirm the "No customer data exposed" line.

claire: I'll draft the 72-hour customer brief. Plan: TL;DR, concise timeline, impact metrics (pct requests affected, median latency), top-4 FAQs, and links to support contact for enterprise follow-up.

legal-bot: Legal POV: prefer a redacted public summary (remove orchestration commands, internal hostnames, exact rollout steps). Full technical RCA can be shared with customers under NDA/DPA; we need a redaction stencil to review.

sec: Security confirms no exfiltration detected. You may include the "No customer data exposed" statement. We'll add a short security addendum in the expanded brief.

prodops-bot: Statuspage draft recorded in #statuspage-drafts. ProdOps can push once copy is finalized and signed off by legal/sec.

eng-runtime: Noted recurring pattern: similar KV eviction spikes in Feb and early Mar. Eng-runtime will create a guardrail ticket to throttle rollouts and limit eviction window. Ticket: RUNTIME-2044, P1.

miguel: For enterprise outreach, Sales can export affected accounts once Claire posts the impacted-customer list. I'll coordinate the messaging template for affected customers.

sylvie: Action items and owners (please react when done):
- Omar: finalize and post statuspage sentence to #statuspage-drafts (due 2423141620)
- Claire: post 72-hour customer brief draft here for review (due 2423141640)
- Legal: publish redaction stencil/list for public copy (due 2423141630)
- Sec: provide the short security addendum for expanded brief (due 2423141635)
- Eng-runtime (RUNTIME-2044): add guardrail ticket and estimate ETA (due 2423141660)
- Miguel/Sales: prepare enterprise outreach plan after Claire's brief (due 2423141650)

omar: Posted statuspage copy to #statuspage-drafts and pinged ProdOps.

claire: Draft 72-hour brief posted below. Will iterate after Legal's stencil and Sec addendum.

legal-bot: Redaction stencil posted: remove internal service names, orchestration commands, node IPs, customer IDs, and CI/CD playbook steps. Send any additional sensitive items here.

sec: Security addendum: confirmed no exfiltration, mitigation steps logged, monitoring increased for 72h. Will attach short note to expanded brief.

eng-runtime: Guardrail ticket RUNTIME-2044 created; estimate T-minus 2 sprints for rollout throttle work.

miguel: Sales: preparing affected-account list; will DM Claire.

sylvie: Recurring-pattern note: add a follow-up line in the public brief that we're tracking recurrence and working on permanent guardrails. Keep public phrasing high level.

jen: Once legal and sec sign off on the 72h draft we'll publish the public brief and trigger enterprise outreach. Thanks everyone ":white_check_mark:" when your part is complete.

sylvie: Closing this thread for now; will reopen if any blocker appears."
